      • interact

        public boolean interact​(java.lang.String action)
        Interacts with the given object using an action. Will choose best click type using menu index.

        Example: 

        
 NPC man = NPCs.closest("Man");

 if (man != null && man.interact("Attack")) {
     log("We attacked a man successfully!");
 }
        Parameters:
        action - the action
        Returns:
        results of interaction, true if interaction with the object was successful, otherwise false.
